note: v645: every waiting pill shows the box's plain answer (e.g. "Jump ahead: not at a lock yet"), says "box hasn't confirmed" when no receipt comes, and has a ✕ to cancel the request (the box drops it if not yet acted on; never unseats). Typed lines get one pill with a ✕ too. Agenda pickers show names like "cheat → mean" and the agenda list takes a typed name. An "update ready · tap to reload" chip shows when a new version is out.
